state_normalisation.description: A qubit state a|0> + b|1> has |a|^2 + |b|^2 = 1.

bloch_vector_x.description: The expectation of X in the Bloch-sphere state gives the x component sin(theta) cos(phi).
bloch_vector_x.assumptions: pure single-qubit state with polar angle theta and azimuth phi

bloch_vector_y.description: The expectation of Y in the Bloch-sphere state gives the y component sin(theta) sin(phi).
bloch_vector_y.assumptions: pure single-qubit state with polar angle theta and azimuth phi

bloch_vector_z.description: The expectation of Z in the Bloch-sphere state gives the z component cos(theta).
bloch_vector_z.assumptions: pure single-qubit state with polar angle theta

born_rule_hadamard_plus.description: The Hadamard gate applied to |0> gives outcome 0 with probability one half.

hadamard_unitary.description: The Hadamard matrix is unitary, so the gate preserves norm and can be inverted.

pauli_squares.description: Each Pauli matrix squares to the identity.

pauli_product.description: The product of the Pauli matrices X and Y is i times Z.

rotation_z_unitary.description: The z-rotation gate R_z(theta) is unitary for every angle theta.

bell_state_from_hadamard_and_cnot.description: A Hadamard on the first qubit followed by a CNOT prepares the Bell state (|00> + |11>)/sqrt(2).

grover_two_qubits_one_iteration.description: With four items, one Grover iteration finds the marked item with certainty.

shor_factor_from_order.latex: \gcd(a^{r/2}-1, N)\cdot\gcd(a^{r/2}+1, N) = N \text{ for } N=15,\ a=2,\ r=4
shor_factor_from_order.description: For N = 15 and a = 2, the order r = 4 yields the factors 3 and 5.

qft_unitary_n4.latex: F_N^\dagger F_N = I,\quad F_N = \tfrac{1}{\sqrt N}\,[\omega^{jk}],\ \omega = e^{2\pi i/N},\ N=4
qft_unitary_n4.description: The quantum Fourier transform on four amplitudes is unitary.
